entities.summary: Nestor Dmytriw was a Ukrainian Catholic priest, author, and translator. Dmytriw was born in Utishkiv, Russian Empire. Shortly after his ordination by Metropolitan bishop Sylvester Sembratovych in 1894, he came to the United States in 1895 and settled in Mount Carmel, Pennsylvania. In the US, he quickly became involved with missionary work and journalism through the Jersey City, New Jersey, paper Svoboda.
